verdict.rationale: Fastmail's own docs show it can snooze messages so they return to the Inbox at a set time. Nothing in the pack shows conditional follow-up reminders that resurface a thread only when nobody replies, so only half the story is delivered. Missing for 10: reply-aware follow-up reminders, detailed snooze documentation (options, conversation-level behavior), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies

citations.quote: Snooze messages to just when you need them.
If you're offline when a snoozed message is scheduled to return to your Inbox, you will not see the snoozed message reappear until you're back online.
